data.title: 木更 · 游戏厅
data.description: 【木更 · 游戏厅】五光十色的游戏机厅内音乐震耳欲聋，木更站在音乐节奏游戏机前，双手化作残影精准敲击着每一个音符键位。完成全连击后她兴奋地跳下来抱住你的手臂——「全连破纪录了！修看到了吗！待会儿抓娃娃机里的那个限定玩偶，也一定要帮我抓到哦！」
data.promptProse: Kisara taps the rhythm-game cabinet's buttons with concentrated timing, then beams at a successful sequence. Casual jacket and jeans retain the arcade outfit beneath flowing pink hair. The medium view includes both working hands and the colorful control deck, neighboring cabinets receding beyond. Neon screens and flashing cabinet lights illuminate her excited face and fingertips in shifting colors, with darker machine sides separating the bright controls from the busy arcade depth.
